description: Standardized Architectural, Safety, and Sensor Infrastructure Selection Criteria for Physical Pilot Facilities.

exclusion_zone.description: Physical barricade perimeter enclosing the entire test junction and runout zones.

emergency_shutdown_systems.perimeter_hardwired_e_stops: Minimum 4 illuminated mushroom-head E-Stop buttons along fence boundary
emergency_shutdown_systems.wireless_safety_marshal_e_stop: Dual-channel SIL-3 / Cat-4 certified wireless safety remote held by dedicated marshal
emergency_shutdown_systems.automatic_vehicle_cutoff: Vehicle CAN bus ignition cut-off circuit triggered within <= 100ms of E-Stop command

lighting_and_environmental_control.luminaire_flicker_frequency_hz: >= 1000 Hz (High-frequency LED drivers to eliminate camera rolling-shutter banding)

mounting_locations.camera_a_mount: Rigid structural column or roof truss at 5.0m height along primary corridor centerline
mounting_locations.camera_b_mount: Structural rack upright at 4.5m height overlooking intersection threshold
mounting_locations.camera_c_mount: Interior aisle apex mount at 4.0m height facing down secondary cross-aisle
mounting_locations.camera_d_mount: High diagonal corner ceiling mount at 6.5m height
mounting_locations.structural_vibration_damping: Spring-isolated camera mounting brackets rated for <= 0.05g RMS ambient vibration

network_and_clock_infrastructure.network_topology: Dedicated isolated 10GbE fiber backbone with Category 6A Shielded Twisted Pair (STP) drops
network_and_clock_infrastructure.ptp_grandmaster_location: Secured IT equipment rack within <= 50m cable run of primary network switch
network_and_clock_infrastructure.uninterrupted_power_supply: Dedicated online double-conversion UPS (minimum runtime >= 60 minutes under full sensor load)
network_and_clock_infrastructure.local_storage_array: Redundant NVMe RAID-10 storage server with sustained write bandwidth >= 2.5 GB/s
